integrity: All new statements proved from the established 2026 zero-density formula using Gaussian-weighted finite measures; separate numerical checks are corroborative only. This is not independent validation.
limitations: Population first intensities on the full continuous frequency line; pure noise only; no quantitative finite-sample inverse stability or joint zero-law determination. Spectral scale is unidentifiable. Gaussian deconvolution is ill-conditioned. Historical equivalent formulations remain possible.
scientific_object: First intensity of zeros of Gaussian-window STFT of stationary circular complex Gaussian noise
title: Exact ambiguity orbits and tail rigidity for Gaussian-spectrogram zero intensities
